short.headline: GTA 6 CHEATS ARE REAL
short.text: GTA 6 cheats are real, but there's a catch nobody expected.
short.text_es: Los trucos de GTA 6 existen, pero hay una trampa que nadie esperaba.

short.headline: FINISH THE STORY FIRST
short.text: According to Polygon, GamesRadar and PC Gamer, cheats only unlock after you finish the main story, on that save.
short.text_es: Según Polygon, GamesRadar y PC Gamer, los trucos solo se desbloquean al terminar la historia principal, en esa partida.

short.headline: EARN EACH ONE
short.text: And many cheats need their own challenge too, so just knowing the code isn't enough.
short.text_es: Y muchos trucos piden su propio desafío, así que saberte el código no basta.

short.headline: NO SAVES, NO TROPHIES
short.text: Use one, and saving and trophies turn off for the rest of that session.
short.text_es: Usa uno, y el guardado y los trofeos se apagan el resto de esa sesión.
